citation: Vilsons, Andris (atb. red.). Māksla un arhitektūra biogrāfijās, I. Rīga: Latvijas enciklopēdija, 1995.
title: Māksla un arhitektūra biogrāfijās
isbn_note: Confirmed present in OpenLibrary's merged set record (OL574971M, https://openlibrary.org/books/OL574971M) alongside 4 other ISBNs for the set. OpenLibrary does not bind individual ISBNs to individual volumes (one MARC-derived record covers all 4), so this is assigned to Vol I by process of elimination within the 5-89960-0XX-X (Latvijas enciklopēdija) prefix family, corroborated by LC's table_of_contents field confirming 4 volumes ("1. A-Kal", "2. Kal-Rum", "3. R-V", "4. V-Ž. Papildinājumi A-U"). A fifth, unassigned ISBN in the same set record, 5-89960-058-6, could not be attributed to a specific volume — possibly a variant/reprint of Vol I or II.
oclc_note: Confirmed via OpenLibrary's set record, which lists OCLC 35688304 directly — matches the earlier WorldCat search hit. This is a set-level identifier (one MARC record for all 4 volumes, common for library-catalogued multi-volume works), not Vol-I-specific; a WorldCat/library search on this number will surface the whole set.
lccn_note: Set-level (all 4 volumes), from the same OpenLibrary/LC-derived record as the OCLC number. The Library of Congress record's own notes field states "Vols. 3-4 published by Preses nams. Vol. 3-4 edited by Anita Vanaga" — direct third-party confirmation of this project's volume/editor/publisher table.
